newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off, waiting on CANTV sale.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off, waiting on CANTV sale.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off in slow trade as investors continued to hang back on a lack of details on the long-awaited CANTV share offering, traders said.
The market's 19-share .IBC index lost 1.57 percent to close at 5,759.50 points as 14 million shares traded worth 3.2 billion bolivars ($6.8 million).

"Trade is going to remain shallow while we wait for news about the CANTV placement," said one trader. The government is due to place some 5-10 percent of the company on the Caracas bolsa as part of a November share offering.
Among traded issues, 16 fell, 13 rose and 11 closed flat.

Stock prices of blue chips Electricidad de Caracas, Mavesa and Sivensa continued to adjust from their early October highs, losing 13.75, 1.00 and 5.05 bolivars respectively to close at 505.25, 145.50 and 358.00 bolivars.
Despite the drop, traders said conditions were ripe to take positions.
"Interest rates are low and falling and the market's liquid," said Incambios broker Lupini.
